about: Calibration set for the semantic search filter (docs/design/BUSQUEDA_MULTILINGUE.md). 'expect' lists article titles that count as a correct hit (any of them). An empty 'expect' means the question has no answer in the offline corpus: any result kept by the filter there is a false positive. Written by hand; never generated by the models being measured. Expected titles include the obviously correct Wikipedia Vital alternatives (e.g. 'Genome editing' for CRISPR), added when the Vital pack joined the calibration.
